verdict.rationale: Parahelp documents recurring automations that watch the support queue and surface gaps, on-demand reports on where the Customer Agent falls short, and a release flow in which fixes are reviewed, versioned and revertable. Together these give a review loop that feeds back into the agent. However, nothing documents scoring sampled conversations or flagging individual failed conversations as a QA workflow. Missing for 10: scored conversation samples/QA rubrics, explicit per-conversation failure flagging, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, AI conversations get ongoing QA — scored samples, flagged failures, and a review loop that feeds fixes back into the agent

citations.quote: Set up automations that watch your tools and your support queue and surface gaps on their own.
Prompt the Internal Agent for a report on how your Customer Agent is performing and where it falls short.
An automation is an Internal Agent task that runs on a schedule, like every weekday at 9am
approving a configuration action publishes it as a release - reviewed, versioned, and revertable
